messages.text: Hi I’m interested in the room you have available and would love to come by for a viewing. A little about me, I’m originally from the US and I am on a working holiday visa. I currently work in hospitality so have some random hours but try to work a lot so I’m looking for a relaxing place to call home. I do enjoy a bit of quiet time but also like to be social and share quality time with the people I live with. If you think I sound like I’d be a good fit for the flat I’d love to schedule a viewing soon 😊
